description_en: Resets the consumer offset of a specified Group ID to a specified timestamp. This operation is typically used to clear accumulated messages or replay consumed messages
description_zh: 重置指定的 Group ID 的消费位点到指定时间戳。一般用于清理堆积消息，或者回溯消费
kebab_example: aliyun sofa reset-mq-sofamq-consumer-offset --group-id GID_test_consumer_id --instance-id MQ_INST_111111111111_DOxxxxxx --topic test-mq-topic --type 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResetMqSofamqConsumerOffset

parameters.help_en: The Group ID of the consumer to query
parameters.help_zh: 需查询的消费端 Group ID
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID that corresponds to the Group ID to query. This parameter is required for instances that have independent namespaces
parameters.help_zh: 需查询的 Group ID 所对应的实例 ID。针对有独立命名空间的实例，该参数为必填
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The timestamp to which the consumer offset is reset. This parameter takes effect only when Type is set to 1. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 重置位点到指定的时间戳，仅在 Type 为 1 时生效。单位：毫秒
parameters.name: reset_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The name of the topic for which you want to reset the consumer offset
parameters.help_zh: 需重置位点的 Topic 名称
parameters.name: topic

parameters.help_en:
The message cleanup type. Valid values:
0: clears all messages.
1: clears messages up to a specified time
parameters.help_zh:
消息清理类型，取值说明如下：
0：清除所有消息。
1：清理到指定时间
parameters.name: type
